constraintRules.rule: WM-ECO-035 exclusively masters Engagement, Mandate, declared scope, exclusions and AssuranceOpinion.
WM-ACT-033 exclusively masters commissioned Execution, performed test, observation, evidence package and AuditFinding.
Engagement commissions Execution; one Execution belongs to one Engagement; activity occurs only inside its authorized period, while retained records remain immutable and resolvable after closure.
No merged Audit root, third Audit master or same-instance dual mastership is permitted.
AuditFinding reuses WM-ACT-033 and aligns to WM-KNW-007 without a second identity; WM-KNW-014 Issue remains distinct.

AssuranceOpinion has WM-ECO-035 engagement-scoped issuance identity (engagementRef plus issuanceSequence), cites period, assurance level, modification, use restrictions, evidence limitations, exclusions and frame gaps, and never proves general compliance or closes a finding.
CorrectiveAction profiles WM-ACT-006; management response is a separate assertion attached to the finding.
Finding, issue, risk, control, task, opinion, response and action retain distinct identities and attributed links.
Closure requires a new independent performed test against the same pinned criteria and cell; successor cell requires issuance-authority authorization and recorded equivalence rationale.
Retest executor differs from corrective-action actor; performed-test executor differs from process owner; opinion issuer is independent of audited management.
Tests, observations, evidence references/packages, findings, responses, retests, reports and opinions are append-only; withdrawal requires reason and authority and never edits the predecessor.
The profile mints no subject identity and cannot mutate or cascade-delete any master.
WM-ECO-035 masters the engagement criteria binding and issued report artifact; report does not duplicate AssuranceOpinion identity.
WM-ACT-033 masters performed-test sampling records and engagement-scoped management-response assertions shaped by WM-KNW-007, never WM-ACT-006 actions.
Finding closure decision is recorded by the engagement issuance authority, cites closure criteria and retest; corrective actor, audited management and retest executor cannot decide closure.
Opinion supersession issues a new engagement-scoped issuance referencing the withdrawn predecessor; original remains immutable.
